sourceId.title: Source ID
sourceId.description: The AfriScout source identifier. Used to tag every item this run produces.

sourceUrl.title: Source URL
sourceUrl.description: The public listing URL to crawl. Must be a full https URL.

sourceType.title: Source type
sourceType.description: Source family hint, e.g. GOVERNMENT, PROCUREMENT_PORTAL, UNIVERSITY, NGO, FOUNDATION, ACCELERATOR, GRANT_PORTAL, JOB_BOARD, SCHOLARSHIP_PORTAL, DEVELOPMENT_ORG, PRIVATE_COMPANY, OTHER.

adapter.title: Adapter key
adapter.description: The adapter to use for extraction. One of: government, procurementPortal, university, ngo, foundation, accelerator, grantPortal, jobBoard, scholarshipPortal, genericListing, genericRss, genericSitemap.

country.title: Country code
country.description: Optional two-letter ISO country code (e.g. NG, KE, ZA) used when the source is country-specific.

category.title: Category hint
category.description: Optional opportunity category hint, e.g. PROCUREMENT, GRANTS, SCHOLARSHIPS, EMPLOYMENT.

maxItems.title: Maximum items
maxItems.description: Upper limit on how many items this run should extract.
